_comment: What the character production pipeline can make, for the planning skills (scripts/planning/video_plan.py ready): a plan that needs a capability that is false here is locked with that dependency listed, never changed to another format. Each key is one capability of the shared production bridge (scripts/character/bridge.py). true means the scripts, checks and skills exist; real media, approved characters, narrators and screens are still each video's own inputs.

_what.bridge.B: a silent generated action: hands only, pet only or an approved mascot (segment B); never the app
_what.bridge.C: supplied media: a clip or a still from the plan's assets, checksum, range and source approval at gate B (segment C); a filmed phone goes through the insertion gates of its mode
_what.bridge.narration: a narrator independent of the face: a character's approved performance, a supplied voice, or an original synthetic narrator's approved takes (audio_from)
_what.bridge.composition: split-screen and picture-in-picture panels (segment M), sequential stitch, timed overlays, the source credit and the day counter, checked at gate C
_what.bridge.live: a real input clip paired with its app recording, the measured offset checked in sequence or in panels
_what.bridge.reaction: a silent reaction (segment X): the handle's approved generated face, no voice and no lip sync, performed from the written expression beats of a real reference reaction (reaction_refs), under the timed hook overlay; identity, hands, silence, performance and duration approved at gate B. The reference clip is never a generation input
